_note: Return-vs-warranty regression set, added after the Phase 3 review found the Q3 miss. Written and committed BEFORE any intent-aware retrieval code existed. It is not an unbiased test set, because it was written with knowledge of the failure mode. It checks that a fix generalises beyond Q3 (other products and categories) and does not route return or dead-on-arrival questions to the warranty policy. The Task 5 evaluation queries in rag_queries.json are unchanged.

queries.query: My trimmer stopped working after five months. Will it be repaired for free?
The straightener I bought last year no longer heats up. Is it under warranty?
The sole of my sandals came apart after a month of use. What can I do?
My kitchen mixer broke down after two months. Is that covered?
Can I return a hair dryer I bought four days ago because I don't like it?
My new hair dryer was dead on arrival yesterday. Can I send it back?
